summary.period_coverage_note: Period-end values use the last observed M1 close in the period. An empty period and the allocated equity change on resumption remain unknown; change_since_last_observed_period is a cross-gap difference.
summary.caveat: Synthetic M1 OHLC with stop-first; not broker ticks or a broker margin model. Open equity unobserved during gaps; month-end is observed only.
summary.execution_policy: Opening Market and marketable Limit instructions have confirmation/strategy/input priority; later Limit touches use remaining frozen capacity. Stop-first, adverse gap-through, Limit entry-bar TP deferred, inclusive expiry at observed minute opens, no same-M1 slot recycling.
